promises.quote: the Trust is implementing a revised early warning score National Early Warning Score (NEWS) and Chronic Respiratory Early Warning Score (CREWS) which once implemented is expected to improve compliance with contacting and escalating assistance with deteriorating patients. This is being implemented at Newham University Hospital imminently, as well as across the Trust.
promises.summary: Implement NEWS and CREWS to improve escalation of deteriorating patients

promises.quote: Newham University Hospital has been awarded funding to implement a vital signs monitoring process known as Vitalslink which will transmit clinical observations to the Electronic Patient Record (EPR) by WI-FI and give real-time feedback to the clinician regarding at risk status and the appropriate action to take. This is currently being piloted at Newham University Hospital with wider roll-out planned once the pilot is approved.
promises.summary: Pilot Vitalslink remote monitoring system for real-time patient alerts

promises.quote: the hospital at night meeting and work is under way to improve participation by all on-call teams at night to review and discuss patients flagged as at risk at the start of the shift. This includes the introduction of afternoon safety huddles which are open to all staff and disciplines where issues can be raised and resolved.
promises.summary: Introduce afternoon safety huddles for night shift risk reviews

promises.quote: The Vitalslink system will enable remote observation and alert for patients at risk - this can be used by the outreach team, ward managers and interested clinicians to rapidly detect patients even before the ward nurse has called in their concerns.
promises.summary: Enable remote observation alerts via Vitalslink for early risk detection

promises.quote: There is a daily consultant led trauma meeting in which all admissions, referrals, patients awaiting trauma surgery, post operative patients from the previous day and any sick patients under the care of the orthopaedic service are discussed
promises.summary: Hold daily consultant-led trauma meetings to discuss all relevant patients

promises.quote: Following your Report to Prevent Future Deaths, a section has been added for signing and dating the handover sheet between the member of the team involved and this sheet is retained in the orthopaedic department for audit and transparency purposes.
promises.summary: Add signing and dating to handover sheets for audit
